label: VERIFIED
extraction: Delivery Gate: Stop hook that mechanically blocks Claude from finishing using deterministic checks. Three checks: 1) Rationalization patterns (regex on transcript tail) - warning only ('skip tests for now', 'pre-existing bug'), 2) Stale learning libraries (mtime on 5 paths: growth-log/, decisions/log.md, output-index.md, ratings-tracker.md, tooling_capabilities.md) - warning if some stale, BLOCK if >=3 stale OR growth-log stale + complex task (>=3 edits), 3) Disk space - warn <50GB, BLOCK <15GB. Distinct from self-audit: delivery-gate checks machine-verifiable facts (learning libs touched?), self-audit checks output quality. Installs as Python script in ~/.claude/scripts/quality-gate.py with Stop hook in settings.json. Complex task + no learning captured = blocked.
